decisions.reason: As a core extension of the firm's established coolant-management offering that remained on the market through 2024, it likely still has option value and relatively low carrying cost within the existing sales and service system.

The centrifuge fits the firm's established process-media portfolio and, having survived its first year in a growing industry, is worth keeping while demand and installed-base learning continue to develop.

Although somewhat costlier to carry as a close-to-core conveyor product, its continued presence through 2024 suggests sufficient strategic fit with the firm's automation and material-flow business to justify retaining the option.

The hinged belt chip conveyor is closely aligned with the firm's existing conveying solutions and should be kept because its market potential is not yet fully resolved while it can leverage the firm's broad engineering and service platform.
